subject: AWS sell-with intro & joint account mapping — ClarityBank
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@amazon.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS sell-with intro — ClarityBank (request)

Irene — quick intro. I'm Jordan, the AWS Partner Manager covering the fintech segment in us-west. ClarityBank (Samir Rao, copied) is evaluating a multi-region inference strategy for their customer service automation and embeddings search. They asked if Redwood can join an AWS "sell-with" intro so we can align on a joint account plan and next steps for marketplace listing/credits.

Can you and a technical lead join a 30-minute call next week? High-level agenda: 1) customer goals & timeline, 2) technical fit and infra (VPC/private option), 3) mutual action items for marketplace listing + co-sell enablement.

I attached the AWS sell-with intake form for a quick pre-read.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
AWS Partner Manager — Fintech
Amazon Web Services
attachments: aws-sellwith-intake-form.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@amazon.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@claritybank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS sell-with intro — ClarityBank (request)

Jordan / Samir — thanks for the intro. Happy to join. Karthik (sales engineering) and Laura (partner GTM) are looped for the MAP and marketplace checklist.

Proposed slots (30 min):
- Tue 2028-06-27 10:00 PT
- Wed 2028-06-28 14:00 PT

Can you confirm which works for you and whether Samir wants a short technical pre-brief? If useful, we'll share a one-page joint account map and a draft mutual action plan ahead of the call.

I'll also attach our current joint-account plan template and a short notes doc to speed the kickoff.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: ClarityBank_MAPlan_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS sell-with intro — ClarityBank (prep)

Irene / Laura — quick internal note ahead of the intro:
- I'll own the technical fit and ok to present: private deployment options (VPC), latency targets, estimated cost buckets for 10k/50k QPS patterns.
- Laura, can you surface any relevant marketplace accelerators or credits we've used with other fintech pilots? That will help shape the ask.
- Hannah, please pull the last three similar fintech playbooks for reference (embedding-heavy customer support, multi-tenant constraints).

I'll draft a 1-slide tech overview for the call and ping Samir for any specific compliance questions to prep.

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@claritybank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@amazon.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@claritybank.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS sell-with intro — ClarityBank (confirm)

Thanks, all — Wed 2028-06-28 14:00 PT works for our team (Priya and I). A short technical pre-brief would be helpful — especially around data residency and integration with our existing document store.

Can you send a calendar invite and the brief materials? We're aiming for a short decision window and would like to see a draft mutual action plan and a marketplace ask (credits + listing timeline) during the call.

-Samir
Head of Digital Channels, ClarityBank
